s0101.literal: On gengshen day the court halted east of Orda-erqen Mu.
s0101.idiomatic: On gengshen day the court halted east of Orda-erqen Mu.

s0102.literal: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Boluo and Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Shangjianu were both specially granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, to supervise the four palace guard corps.
s0102.idiomatic: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Boluo and Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Shangjianu were both specially granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies, to supervise the four palace guard corps.

s0103.literal: On guihai day the court halted at Biteqetu; Hanlin academician-director Orda-erqen came from the capital to have audience.
s0103.idiomatic: On guihai day the court halted at Biteqetu; Hanlin academician-director Orda-erqen came from the capital to have audience.

s0104.literal: Orders were issued to the relevant offices to renew Wuzong's tent palace and imperial carriages.
s0104.idiomatic: Orders were issued to the relevant offices to renew Wuzong's tent palace and imperial carriages.

s0105.literal: On gengwu day Yan Timur was ordered to promote officials of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat; the remaining officials were all granted one grade of honorary rank.
s0105.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yan Timur was ordered to promote officials of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat; the remaining officials were all granted one grade of honorary rank.

s0106.literal: Former officials of the latent residence and attendant officers were selected for appointment; eighty-five who received commission edicts, and twenty-six of sixth rank and below.
s0106.idiomatic: Former officials of the latent residence and attendant officers were selected for appointment; 85 who received commission edicts, and 26 of sixth rank and below.

s0107.literal: On renshen day the court halted at Tantuo'erhai.
s0107.idiomatic: On renshen day the court halted at Tantuo'erhai.

s0108.literal: Yilin Zhenba was enfeoffed Prince of Liucheng Commandery; Bajila was made Shaanxi branch censorate grand councillor; Zhongjianu was made associate censor-in-chief.
s0108.idiomatic: Yilin Zhenba was enfeoffed Prince of Liucheng Commandery; Bajila was made Shaanxi branch censorate grand councillor; Zhongjianu was made associate censor-in-chief.

s0109.literal: On yihai day the court halted at Tuhula.
s0109.idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Tuhula.

s0110.literal: An edict directed the Dadu provincial officials to cast the crown prince's seal.
s0110.idiomatic: An edict directed the Dadu provincial officials to cast the crown prince's seal.

s0111.literal: At the time the former crown prince's seal could not be found; attendant Bobuhua said the seal was stored in the Shangdu travel encampment; men were sent to Shangdu to seek it but nothing was obtained, and orders were then issued to cast a new one.
s0111.idiomatic: At the time the former crown prince's seal could not be found; attendant Bobuhua said the seal was stored in the Shangdu travel encampment; men were sent to Shangdu to seek it but nothing was obtained, and orders were then issued to cast a new one.

s0112.literal: Forty-three relay stations including Ximulin suffered drought disaster; the central secretariat was ordered to grant grain in relief, totaling eight thousand two hundred shi.
s0112.idiomatic: Forty-three relay stations including Ximulin suffered drought disaster; the central secretariat was ordered to grant grain in relief, totaling 8,200 shi.

s0113.literal: On dingchou day the crown prince departed the capital.
s0113.idiomatic: On dingchou day the crown prince departed the capital.

s0114.literal: Prince of Zhennan Tiemur Buqa, princes Yesu, Woji, Dalaibuhua, Duolaizhiban, and Boyeyebogan, imperial son-in-law Biejanli, and attendant guards and the hundred offices all followed on the journey.
s0114.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Tiemur Buqa, princes Yesu, Woji, Dalaibuhua, Duolaizhiban, and Boyeyebogan, imperial son-in-law Biejanli, and attendant guards and the hundred offices all followed on the journey.

s0115.literal: On wuyin day two hundred eighty horses were purchased in the capital and loaded with imperial carriage accoutrements to be sent to the imperial whereabouts.
s0115.idiomatic: On wuyin day 280 horses were purchased in the capital and loaded with imperial carriage accoutrements to be sent to the imperial whereabouts.

s0116.literal: On jimao day the court halted east of the Tuhula River.
s0116.idiomatic: On jimao day the court halted east of the Tuhula River.

s0117.literal: Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.
s0117.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-director Tangqutu was promoted to grand preceptor.

s0118.literal: The tribes of Prince of Zhao Mazahan suffered drought; fifty-five thousand four hundred persons could not support themselves; the Hedong pacification commission was ordered to grant two months' relief grain.
s0118.idiomatic: The tribes of Prince of Zhao Mazahan suffered drought; 55,400 persons could not support themselves; the Hedong pacification commission was ordered to grant 2 months' relief grain.

s0119.literal: On gengchen day Prince Yanzigetai was granted two hundred ingots of notes and two thousand bolts of silks.
s0119.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Yanzigetai was granted 200 ingots of notes and 2,000 bolts of silks.

s0120.literal: On xinsi day the court halted at Oloroqutu.
s0120.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court halted at Oloroqutu.

s0121.literal: On renwu day the court halted at Bulutong.
s0121.idiomatic: On renwu day the court halted at Bulutong.

s0122.literal: That day left grand councillor Temur Buqa and others, on account of the Emperor's accession, reported by proxy at the Southern Suburb.
s0122.idiomatic: That day left grand councillor Temur Buqa and others, on account of the Emperor's accession, reported by proxy at the Southern Suburb.

s0123.literal: On jiashen day the court halted at Hulahuo Shiwen.
s0123.idiomatic: On jiashen day the court halted at Hulahuo Shiwen.

s0124.literal: Sixth month, on dinghai new moon, the court halted at Kundu ye Bulaq.
s0124.idiomatic: Sixth month, on dinghai new moon, the court halted at Kundu ye Bulaq.

s0125.literal: That day Temur Buqa and others, on account of the Emperor's accession, reported by proxy at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the altars of soil and grain.
s0125.idiomatic: That day Temur Buqa and others, on account of the Emperor's accession, reported by proxy at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the altars of soil and grain.

s0126.literal: On wuzi day Yan Timur and others memorialized: "The Central Domestic Affairs Court, overstepping the central secretariat, has on its own authority memorialized appointments and removals, and sent documents demanding commission edicts; appointments have already been made as requested, yet this is not proper in the larger scheme of affairs; we request that orders be issued forbidding this, so that governmental authority may be unified.
s0126.idiomatic: On wuzi day Yan Timur and others memorialized: "The Central Domestic Affairs Court, overstepping the central secretariat, has on its own authority memorialized appointments and removals, and sent documents demanding commission edicts; appointments have already been made as requested, yet this is not proper in the larger scheme of affairs; we request that orders be issued forbidding this, so that governmental authority may be unified.

s0128.literal: On gengyin day the court halted at Sali.
s0128.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court halted at Sali.

s0129.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported famine; envoys were sent back to the capital to consult with the senior ministers on relief.
s0129.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported famine; envoys were sent back to the capital to consult with the senior ministers on relief.

s0130.literal: On dingyou day the court halted at Wuna'ba.
s0130.idiomatic: On dingyou day the court halted at Wuna'ba.

s0131.literal: The Commissionerate was promoted to Grand Commissionerate.
s0131.idiomatic: The Commissionerate was promoted to Grand Commissionerate.

s0132.literal: On jihai day the court halted at Kuoduo.
s0132.idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at Kuoduo.

s0133.literal: The privy council memorialized: "The crown prince has sent envoys saying that edicts have recently been issued directing that troops of the various Sichuan provinces all be sent back to their camps; only Yunnan's rebellious designs cannot be measured, and the troops cannot immediately be disbanded; your subjects report this for the throne's information.
s0133.idiomatic: The privy council memorialized: "The crown prince has sent envoys saying that edicts have recently been issued directing that troops of the various Sichuan provinces all be sent back to their camps; only Yunnan's rebellious designs cannot be measured, and the troops cannot immediately be disbanded; your subjects report this for the throne's information.

s0134.literal: " The Emperor said: "They may continue garrison duty; disband them only after pacification is complete.
s0134.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "They may continue garrison duty; disband them only after pacification is complete.

s0135.literal: " On xinchou day the court halted at Saliqier.
s0135.idiomatic: " On xinchou day the court halted at Saliqier.

s0136.literal: On renyin day attendants were admonished not to memorialize on their own authority.
s0136.idiomatic: On renyin day attendants were admonished not to memorialize on their own authority.

s0137.literal: On jiachen day imperial son-in-law Tobu'er was granted one thousand ingots of notes and sent to Yunnan.
s0137.idiomatic: On jiachen day imperial son-in-law Tobu'er was granted 1,000 ingots of notes and sent to Yunnan.

s0138.literal: On dingwei day the court halted at Haliwen.
s0138.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court halted at Haliwen.

s0139.literal: On wushen day the court halted at Kuoduo Jie Alun.
s0139.idiomatic: On wushen day the court halted at Kuoduo Jie Alun.

s0140.literal: On xinhai day the court halted at Harqanatu.
s0140.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court halted at Harqanatu.

s0141.literal: An edict instructed the central secretariat officials: "For all major state affairs concerning revenue and grain and appointments and removals, first inform the crown prince, and then report to Us.
s0141.idiomatic: An edict instructed the central secretariat officials: "For all major state affairs concerning revenue and grain and appointments and removals, first inform the crown prince, and then report to Us.

s0142.literal: " On guichou day the court halted at Huttu.
s0142.idiomatic: On guichou day the court halted at Huttu.

s0143.literal: On jiayin day one thousand eight hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief to twenty-three relay stations of Lintong and Huayin in Shaanxi, and eight hundred ingots of notes to fifteen relay stations of Jinning Route.
s0143.idiomatic: On jiayin day 1,800 ingots of notes were granted in relief to 23 relay stations of Lintong and Huayin in Shaanxi, and 800 ingots of notes to 15 relay stations of Jinning Route.

s0144.literal: That month Temur Buqa, on account of prolonged drought, reported to the crown prince, resigned his chancellorship, and requested that another worthy be selected and entrusted with harmonizing governance; the crown prince sent envoys to report this.
s0144.idiomatic: That month Temur Buqa, on account of prolonged drought, reported to the crown prince, resigned his chancellorship, and requested that another worthy be selected and entrusted with harmonizing governance; the crown prince sent envoys to report this.

s0145.literal: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.
s0145.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed Kuorugusi and others: "Cultivating virtue to respond to Heaven is what ruler and ministers ought to do; what Temur Buqa said is indeed right.

s0146.literal: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.
s0146.idiomatic: Heaven's clarity is to be feared; We have never for an instant forgotten this in Our heart.

s0147.literal: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.
s0147.idiomatic: When the crown prince comes to meet Us, We should together plan what can benefit the people and bring them material good, and put it into practice.

s0148.literal: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials.
s0148.idiomatic: You should convey Our meaning to the hundred officials.

s0149.literal: " Seventh month, on bingchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0149.idiomatic: " Seventh month, on bingchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0150.literal: On jiazi day the court halted at Boluo Huoni.
s0150.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court halted at Boluo Huoni.

s0151.literal: On renshen day surveillance censor Badi Yusi memorialized: "Since last autumn the court has ordered generals to take the field and suppress calamitous disorder; supplies for the armies, rewards for officers and soldiers, and expenditures cannot be reckoned.
s0151.idiomatic: On renshen day surveillance censor Badi Yusi memorialized: "Since last autumn the court has ordered generals to take the field and suppress calamitous disorder; supplies for the armies, rewards for officers and soldiers, and expenditures cannot be reckoned.

s0152.literal: If compared with annual revenue from regular taxes, what has been spent already exceeds it several times over.
s0152.idiomatic: If compared with annual revenue from regular taxes, what has been spent already exceeds it several times over.

s0153.literal: Moreover, the princes' assemblies according to former custom have not yet been fully supplied in any respect; Shaanxi and other places have been repeatedly stricken by famine; the starved lie pillow to pillow; and with the turn from winter to spring, snow and rain have missed their season, wheat seedlings have withered and died, and autumn fields remain unplanted; the people are anxious, and those drifting away in migration are many.
s0153.idiomatic: Moreover, the princes' assemblies according to former custom have not yet been fully supplied in any respect; Shaanxi and other places have been repeatedly stricken by famine; the starved lie pillow to pillow; and with the turn from winter to spring, snow and rain have missed their season, wheat seedlings have withered and died, and autumn fields remain unplanted; the people are anxious, and those drifting away in migration are many.

s0154.literal: Your subject reflects that this is precisely the time for the state to economize.
s0154.idiomatic: Your subject reflects that this is precisely the time for the state to economize.

s0155.literal: If there are those who must be rewarded for merit, their offices' high or low standing should be weighed in granting lighter or heavier rewards; not only would expenses be saved, encouragement could also be shown.
s0155.idiomatic: If there are those who must be rewarded for merit, their offices' high or low standing should be weighed in granting lighter or heavier rewards; not only would expenses be saved, encouragement could also be shown.

s0156.literal: The attendant ministers' memorial requests for gracious grants should all be halted, to ease the people's strength.
s0156.idiomatic: The attendant ministers' memorial requests for gracious grants should all be halted, to ease the people's strength.

s0157.literal: " The censorate reported this; the Emperor praised and accepted it, and still ordered the central secretariat to show what was said to the hundred offices.
s0157.idiomatic: " The censorate reported this; the Emperor praised and accepted it, and still ordered the central secretariat to show what was said to the hundred offices.

s0158.literal: On yihai day the court halted at Buluo Chahan.
s0158.idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Buluo Chahan.

s0159.literal: On bingzi day Wenzong received the crown prince's seal.
s0159.idiomatic: On bingzi day Wenzong received the crown prince's seal.

s0160.literal: On wuyin day the court halted at Xiaozhi.
s0160.idiomatic: On wuyin day the court halted at Xiaozhi.

s0161.literal: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat associate administrator Qabildar together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
s0161.idiomatic: On renwu day envoys were dispatched to the capital, directing central secretariat associate administrator Qabildar together with Hanlin National History Academy officials to perform sacrifice to the imperial portraits of the three reigns of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.

s0162.literal: Six thousand troops from the various guards were dispatched to complete the capital's defenses.
s0162.idiomatic: 6,000 troops from the various guards were dispatched to complete the capital's defenses.

s0163.literal: Eighth month, on yiyou new moon, the court halted at Wanghuchadu.
s0163.idiomatic: Eighth month, on yiyou new moon, the court halted at Wanghuchadu.

s0164.literal: On bingxu day the crown prince entered to have audience.
s0164.idiomatic: On bingxu day the crown prince entered to have audience.

s0165.literal: That day the crown prince and the princes and great ministers were feasted at the travel palace.
s0165.idiomatic: That day the crown prince and the princes and great ministers were feasted at the travel palace.

s0166.literal: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was thirty years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
s0166.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Emperor died suddenly; he was 30 years old and was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

s0167.literal: That month, on jihai day, the crown prince again assumed the imperial throne.
s0167.idiomatic: That month, on jihai day, the crown prince again assumed the imperial throne.

s0168.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.
s0168.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on yisi day, privy council administrator Chenye Bulun and others deliberated and requested the posthumous title Emperor Yixian Jingxiao and the temple name Mingzong.

s0169.literal: Third year, third month, on renshen day, he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0169.idiomatic: Third year, third month, on renshen day, he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0171.literal: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.
s0171.idiomatic: Yuan Shi, juan 31: First month of Tianshun 2, on yichou day Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left associate administrator Yiltemur to welcome him.

s0172.literal: On yiyou day Sadi and others arrived and had audience with the Emperor at the travel encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.
s0172.idiomatic: On yiyou day Sadi and others arrived and had audience with the Emperor at the travel encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.

s0173.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor took the throne north of Hening; the princes and great ministers accompanying the journey all entered to congratulate.
s0173.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor took the throne north of Hening; the princes and great ministers accompanying the journey all entered to congratulate.

s0174.literal: He then ordered Sadi to send men back to report to the capital.
s0174.idiomatic: He then ordered Sadi to send men back to report to the capital.
